quotes.title: GJ 1252
quotes.card: GJ 1252 is a red dwarf star located 66.5 light-years away from the Solar System in the constellation of Telescopium.
quotes.introduction: The star has about 38% the mass and 39% the radius of the Sun, and a temperature of about 3,458 K. GJ 1252 is orbited by one known exoplanet.
